meta.title: Team AI Balancer
meta.description: Rotate Agent Teams teammates (and optional subagents) across a weighted pool of LLM providers (DeepSeek, GLM, others), route image/visual work to GLM and code/table work to DeepSeek, and prompt the Lead to split substantial tasks across 2-4 teammates. Assignments persist across restarts while the Lead keeps its own model. Edited from the Plugins page.
